archetypes.name: dyn-summary-publish
archetypes.rationale: Pre-copy rendering changes the /design log publish choke point.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the design log publish flow and its new final-summary render hook. Focus on whether render failures stay non-gating, stale summaries cannot be copied, and tracking-comment upserts remain suppressed during pre-copy rendering. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
